ModMetaData.name: Bulk Load
ModMetaData.author: pineappleLemonade67
ModMetaData.description:
Pawns use their inventory to carry more, reducing wasted trips across the colony.

Features:
- Bulk load transport pods, shuttles, and pit gates
- Bulk load portals (Anomaly)
- Unload carrier animals and pack animals in one pass
- Crafting: gather all ingredients for a recipe in one trip instead of one per ingredient type
- Unload leftover goods (Mod Settings): helps returning caravan members shelve goods they hold onto

No mod dependencies beyond Harmony. Works best with increased carry capacity.
